title: 第24章 送去见公安
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “大队长，那这……我家孩子妈怎么办？”李祝英拉着大队长到一边，小声询问。“这事我刚刚故意没提，就是想给咱们老李家留个脸面。”大队长悄悄抬眼看了看不远处义愤填膺的徐喜弟。“人直接捉在床上绑过来的，不好办。得看那两个小年轻，站哪边。”“我看那张家小媳妇的意思，想把赵丁往死里整，还有李二拐。”“你家这个情况，如果是真两人自愿搞在一起，那日后少不了吃唾沫。”“还有你家姑娘不是嫁到村外去了嘛，只怕在婆家要抬不起头了，自己想想该怎么办。”“这两个老流氓，我现在带人，立马送公安局去。你领着你家这口子，一起跟上。”“到了公安局，该怎么说，你们路上自己先好好琢磨琢磨。”李队长说完，招手摇了四个人，“我们几个一起，把人送公安局去。”四人听话地自觉两人一组，分别押上赵丁和李二拐。“徐喜弟，你是见证人，又是受害者家属，一同去一趟镇上吧。”李队长来到徐喜弟跟前，交代了一句。然后又问刘宇宁。“刘宇宁，你还去吗？听说明天就要去镇上工作了。”“现在时间不早了，去镇上一趟，来回就得大半天……”王秀菊连忙站出来，把人拉住，“队长，我们宇宁可以不用去了吧？他就是帮帮忙而已。”“明天还要去工作，还没去单位先进了公安局，不吉利。”李队长点点头，他就是这个意思。村里好不容易出了个去镇上当官的，将来说不定就少不得找他帮衬，这件腌臜事，能让他置身事外就最好。“宇宁哥，你别去了。我跟队长他们去就行。”徐喜弟也觉得，他帮忙已经帮够了。这趟浑水，能不让他掺和就不要掺和。“我还是一起去吧……”刘宇宁看着徐喜弟。虽然让她跟着大队长他们一起，没什么可不放心的，可他就是想多和她待一待。“你别去了，这事你别管，听我的。”徐喜弟坚持不让他去。王秀菊总算多看了徐喜弟一眼，这小丫头片子，在是非面前，还是深明大义的。“对啊，你去也说不上什么话，回家收拾东西，明天一早就要出门，别折腾了。”“好。”刘宇宁总算听话了。于是一行人浩浩荡荡出村。“行了，都散了，都散了。”李队长摆摆手，让依旧想看瓜的村民赶紧散场。村里分地的时候，都没这么热闹，一个个眸子亮得刺眼。……镇上公安局里。公安看着被绑的赵丁和李二拐，皱了皱眉头。“你们这么私自绑人，是犯法的懂不懂？”李队长弯着腰，小心翼翼上去解释，“公安同志，这两人耍流氓，通奸，受害者还是残疾人……”“什么？！”公安一听受害者是残疾人，鄙视地看了一眼赵丁和李二拐，默默从裤腰带后面拿出一对银手镯。人还没扣，先哐哐两声，两人脑门上肉眼可见地冒起一个大包。“有证人吗？来说说，具体细节。”“我就是证人，受害者是我大姑姐，从小哑巴，心智只有八九岁……”徐喜弟不卑不亢站出来，把事情的经过，详细描述了一遍。她刚说完，李家婶子就噗通往地上一跪，“公安同志，你们要替我做主啊，我完完全全是被迫的！”“怎么回事？说来听听……”公安皱着眉，这个妇女话还没问到她，就跪地上，有点头疼。徐喜弟原本打算作证两人瞎搞的，可是她一路上想过了，如果李婶也咬定赵丁强迫，那不是可以多关几年？要是能一枪毙了，更好。如果是狼狈为奸，说不定就只是让人吐几口唾沫……所以现在李婶跪地说自己被强迫，她没有再吭声。……公安逐一问了话后，就直接把赵丁和李二拐扣下了。“行了，你们回去吧。”“公安同志，冒昧问一下，这两人大概会怎么判？”李队长回村还得开会交代，所以他得打听清楚。“现在严打呢，我估计的话，这个老的比较恶劣，怎么也得十五年吧。至于那个年轻的，也得五、六年。”李队长一听，在额头上抹了一把汗。他走出公安办公室，那几个人都在门口等着，“队长，怎么说？”“一个十五年，一个五、六年。”“这么久！”“主要李二拐，为了给自己减罪，指认赵丁最少五次……”几人唏嘘不已。回城路上，大家都得很快，李婶远远跟在后面，也不敢和徐喜弟同行，生怕她说出什么来。……回到村里，已经是深夜了。张家还点着等，范金花就坐在堂屋，等消息。徐喜弟一进门，就问吃的，“妈，给我留饭了吗？我连午饭都没吃上，饿扁了。”“有，你快吃点。”范金花推着她去火房，从锅里拿出一碗热饭。就坐在一边看着她吃，一个字都不问。等她吃饱，就着急忙慌把人推进去，“没几个小时就该天亮了……”什么？徐喜弟从进门到吃完饭，都没几分钟，连一个字都没说上，婆婆就这么着急让她进屋睡觉？也不好奇她今天去公安局的结果？徐喜弟撇了撇嘴，关门。房门刚带上，一双大手就环住了她腰。熟悉的味道，熟悉的怀抱。她长长吁了一口气，心里竟然有些暗喜。还以为今天太晚，就不来了呢！没想到在屋里等她。这感觉，有点怪怪的。但他似乎有些猴急，迫不及待把她拥到床边，也没上去，就只是利落地去掉了所有的麻烦。然后站在她的身后。徐喜弟两手紧紧抓着蚊帐柱，咬着牙一连哼了好几声。还……还能这样！蚊帐被摇了很久，蚊帐肚上用来挡灰的塑料薄膜，哗，哗，哗响个不停。也不知道过了多久，鸡笼里的公鸡噗噗噗拍打翅膀。喔~喔~喔~天，真的快亮了。徐喜弟的腰也快垮了，已经弯成了九十度。她突然，想回头看看……
content_en: "Captain, what about... what should I do with the mother of my child?" Li Zhuying pulled the captain aside and asked in a low voice."I didn't mention this on purpose just now, just to save face for our old Li family." The captain quietly raised his eyes and looked at the indignant Xu Xidi who was not far away."It's not easy to catch someone and tie them up on the bed. It depends on which side the two young men are on." "I think the Zhang family's daughter-in-law wants to kill Zhao Ding and Li Erguai." "In your family's situation, if the two of them get together voluntarily, they will have to spit on each other in the future." "And your girl has married outside the village. I'm afraid she won't be able to hold her head up in her husband's family. I think.Think about what to do." "I'll take these two old gangsters and send them to the Public Security Bureau immediately.You can lead your family and follow them together." "When you get to the Public Security Bureau, you should think about it on the way." After Captain Li said, he waved to the four people, "Let's send them to the Public Security Bureau together." The four of them obeyed and escorted Zhao Ding and Li Erguai."Xu Xidi, you are a witness and a family member of the victim. Let's go to the town together." Captain Li came to Xu Xidi and explained.Then he asked Liu Yuning."Liu Yuning, are you still going? I heard that you are going to work in the town tomorrow." "It's getting late now. It takes a long time to go to the town and back..." Wang Xiuju quickly stood up and stopped the person, "Captain, can we Yuning not go? He is just helping." "We have to go to work tomorrow. It's unlucky to go to the Public Security Bureau before going to work." Captain Li nodded, that's what he meant.The village finally got a man who went to the town to be an official. In the future, he might have to be asked for help. It would be best if he could stay out of this embarrassing matter."Brother Yuning, don't go. I'll just go with the captain and the others." Xu Xidi also felt that he had helped enough.If you can't let him get involved in this muddy water, don't get involved."I'd better go together..." Liu Yuning looked at Xu Xidi.Although there was nothing to worry about letting her follow the captain and the others, he just wanted to spend more time with her."Don't go. Don't worry about this. Just listen to me." Xu Xidi insisted not to let him go.Wang Xiuju finally took another look at Xu Xidi. This little girl still knew what was right and wrong when it came to right and wrong."Yeah, you can't say anything if you go. Go home and pack your things. You have to go out early tomorrow morning. Don't bother." "Okay." Liu Yuning finally obeyed.So a group of people left the village in great force."Okay, it's all gone, it's all gone." Captain Li waved his hand and told the villagers who still wanted to see the melons to leave quickly.When the land was divided in the village, it was not so lively, and everyone's eyes were so bright that they were dazzling....In the town’s public security bureau.The police officer looked at the kidnapped Zhao Ding and Li Erguai and frowned."Do you understand that it is against the law for you to kidnap someone privately?" Captain Li bent down and cautiously went up to explain, "Comrade Public Security, these two people are playing hooligans and committing adultery, and the victim is a disabled person..." "What?!" When the police heard that the victim was a disabled person, they looked at Zhao Ding and Li Erguai with contempt, and silently took out a pair of silver bracelets from the back of their waistbands.Before they could buckle, there were two bangs, and a big bump was visible to the naked eye on their foreheads."Are there any witnesses? Tell me the specific details." "I am the witness. The victim is my eldest aunt. She has been mute since she was a child and has the mental capacity of only eight or nine years old..." Xu Xidi stood up and described what happened in detail.As soon as she finished speaking, Aunt Li knelt on the ground and said, "Comrade Public Security, you have to make the decision for me. I was completely forced to do so!" "What's going on? Tell me..." The police officer frowned. Before the woman could ask her any questions, she knelt on the ground, feeling a little headache.Xu Xidi originally planned to testify that the two were fooling around, but she thought about it along the way. If Aunt Li also insisted that Zhao Ding was forced to do so, wouldn't she be able to be imprisoned for a few more years?It would be better if he could be killed with one shot.If it was a conspiracy, maybe it would just be a few spits... So now Aunt Li knelt down and said that she was being forced, and she didn't say anything anymore....After the police questioned them one by one, they directly detained Zhao Ding and Li Erguai."Okay, you can go back." "Comrade Public Security, I would like to ask, how will these two people be sentenced?" Captain Li had to hold a meeting to explain when he returned to the village, so he had to find out clearly."We're going to crack down hard now. I estimate that the old one is the worse one and it will take fifteen years anyway. As for the young one, it will take five or six years." Upon hearing this, Captain Li wiped a handful of sweat from his forehead.He walked out of the public security office, and those people were waiting at the door, "Captain, what do you say?" "One is fifteen years, the other is five or six years." "So long!" "Main Li Erguai, in order to reduce his crime, identified Zhao Ding at least five times..." Several people sighed.On the way back to the city, everyone had to hurry. Aunt Li followed far behind and did not dare to go with Xu Xidi for fear that she would say something....It was already late at night when we returned to the village.The Zhang family was still waiting, and Fan Jinhua was sitting in the main room, waiting for news.As soon as Xu Xidi entered the door, he asked about food, "Mom, did you leave any food for me? I didn't even have lunch, I'm starving." "Yes, eat something quickly." Fan Jinhua pushed her to the fire room and took out a bowl of hot rice from the pot.Just sit and watch her eat without asking a word.When she was full, she hurriedly pushed people in, "It will be dawn in a few hours..." What?From the time Xu Xidi entered the house to the time she finished eating, it only took a few minutes, and she didn't even say a word. Why is her mother-in-law so anxious to let her go into the house to sleep?I'm not curious about the outcome of her visit to the Public Security Bureau today?Xu Xidi curled his lips and closed the door.As soon as the door was closed, a pair of big hands wrapped around her waist.Familiar taste, familiar embrace.She let out a long breath, feeling secretly happy.I thought it was too late today, so I wouldn’t come!I didn't expect to be waiting for her in the house.This feeling is a bit weird.But he seemed a little impatient and couldn't wait to hug her to the bedside without getting up. He just got rid of all the troubles neatly.Then stood behind her.Xu Xidi grasped the mosquito net pole tightly with both hands, gritted his teeth and hummed several times in succession.Still...it can still be like this!The mosquito net has been shaken for a long time, and the plastic film on the belly of the mosquito net to keep out dust keeps making a squeaking sound.I don’t know how long it took, but the rooster in the chicken coop flapped its wings.Oh~oh~oh~Oh my God, it’s really almost dawn.Xu Xidi's waist was about to collapse, already bent at ninety degrees.She suddenly wanted to look back...
